summary: scripts/st-test keeps all repositories' worktree pools together under ST_TEST_POOL_MAX_GB (default 60, 0/off for none): before a run it evicts the least recently used trees and targets whose lock is free until the pool directory fits, never one in use, and logs what it removed.

replay.detail: st-test only (a local pre-sign script); no protocol, schema, policy, workflow or note change.
